marco: quick heads-up 1: planned staging wave 02:15 UTC touches API header-split + router parse-buffer change + console route tweak. propose pin runtime for window and place a hold until prewarm + short canary.
anya: +1 to pin. saw parse_overflow on shard-6 last run when header >4k. small spike in kv_eviction.
anya: logs:
[staging-router] WARN parse_overflow id=shard-6
[staging-runtime] INFO kv_eviction count=27 reason=header_pressure
olivia: rollback criteria: sustained 5xx >0.5% for 10m OR kv_eviction_rate >0.02 for 5m OR session.reset_rate doubles. abort if canary p95 >600ms.
marco: proposed commands:
/deploy hold staging --reason "cross-service-header-safety" --by marco --until 3067813500
/deploy prewarm staging --shard shard-6 --type cache --by marco
deploy-bot: scheduled release at 2025-03-14T02:15Z for staging. run `/deploy hold staging` to place a hold.
infra-bot: note: temporary tcp buffer bump applied in staging for the window. will auto-revert.
anya: i've added a short grafana panel for `router.parse_overflow`, `kv_eviction_rate`, `api.header_size_p95`. linking in the release doc.
marco: pin runtime -> v2.18.0 for staging window and placing the hold now. keep console split FF off during warmup.
marco: (running) `/deploy hold staging --reason "cross-service-header-safety"`
deploy-bot: hold placed by marco at 3067810021 (reason: cross-service-header-safety)
anya: starting prewarm on shard-6. deploy-bot will report when done.
deploy-bot: prewarm accepted; ETA ~12m. id=3067810160
anya: quick smoke after prewarm: 5xx=0.14%, kv_eviction_rate=0.006. within thresholds.
olivia: lift criteria: 15m stable canary with 5xx <0.2% and kv_eviction_rate <0.01 and p50 <320ms. else rollback.
marco: will unhold after 15m stable and post release id. please keep updates short here for oncall.
